edits.old: Then no agent run is started
edits.new:
Then no agent run is started

  Scenario: AC11 The rules BR6 to BR12 hold at the service boundary
    Given a calling step runs in its own schema and transaction
    When the step operation reaches an agent
    Then the client runs under the calling identity and the agent runs its tools as the rwb-agent service identity
    Then no calling step reads agent_run, agent_policy or a record table in another schema
    Then the step operation is one hop under /api/recovery/agent/v1 with the policy timeout as its budget
    Then the decision record is written by the calling step through the local library in its own transaction
    Then the mode, the timeout, the prompt version and the fallback rule are read from the approved policy row
    Then the link between a run and a record is written once and a different record for the same run is refused with 409
    Then the values of mode, run status and product group are read from the rwb-case reference-data contract

  Scenario: AC12 Error answer 401 of the provided operations
    Given the caller presents no valid identity
    When it calls GET /api/recovery/agent/v1/admin/agent-runs through the route
    Then the system refuses the call with 401

  Scenario: AC12 Error answer 404 of the provided operations
    Given the requested agent run does not exist
    When the caller reads that agent run through the route
    Then the system answers 404

  Scenario: AC13 A status change the model does not allow is refused
    Given the rule result names a next state that the model does not allow from the current status of case RW-2026-000201
    When the step runs
    Then the system refuses the status change and case RW-2026-000201 keeps its state and status
    Then the refusal code is Not specified in the source documents (NEWAC-RWB-P10-TE013-APP-AC13)
